correctness.rationale: The complete affine degree-two discriminant is 4[(b²−a²)(u⁴+1)+(4c²−2a²−2b²)u²]; parameter conditions make it squarefree and avoid simultaneous coefficient zeros. Riemann–Hurwitz gives smooth genus one; exact symbolic checker verifies invariance and discriminant. Commuting tensor lifts linearize O(1,1), hence the ruled bundle and blowup, while restrictions to the negative section prohibit linearizing O(1,0) because the two lifts anticommute. Pic(X) has four invariant generators, the other two G-linearized; h1+h2 is G-linearized, proving the complete Amitsur group is precisely Z/2. Fano geometry/Picard basis are verified against cited published descriptions.

value.rationale: The latest source expressly leaves the maximal order-four possibility in family 4.2 open. A uniform nonempty two-dimensional family with provably nonzero exact order-two obstruction is a geometrically constructed lower-bound example, not an arbitrary isolated number or textbook restatement: the invariant smooth genus-one centers and the Schur class surviving their blow-up are mathematically necessary. The result helps delineate the realizability gap without claiming its full resolution.
